column3: Bash reads are unguarded without the sandbox; permissions.deny Read() rules cover only the Read/Edit tools (docs/sandbox-notes.md)
lands in the fixture bare remote only

ask rule the rtk hook does not rewrite; headless -p cannot satisfy an ask rule (no prompt) so bypassPermissions denies it. Rewritten ask commands (git push, git checkout .) execute under yolo; interactive yolo would execute this too. Restriction of the AFK/headless environment, not the profile.
